settings.heading: What is the best dose of Berberine?
settings.row_content:
We've made it flexible and simple to incorporate Orenda Burn® into your daily routine. Here's the scoop:

Both Orenda Burn® 60-count and 180-count bottles offer a wide range of health and wellness benefits. Whether you're just beginning or fully committed to your wellness journey, we've got an option that's perfect for you!

Our 60-count bottle offers a great way to start your Orenda Burn® journey. For those ready to fully embrace the benefits, our 180-count bottle provides a full month's supply at the clinically studied level.

For optimal results based on clinical research, we recommend taking six capsules daily, two 30 minutes before each meal, for simplicity. This provides you with 1,000 mg of Berberine HCl—the standard, research-backed dose that makes our formula so effective.

settings.heading: How long does it take for Berberine to work?
settings.row_content: Like most nutritional supplements, it takes some time for berberine to build up in your body to deliver beneficial results. While studies vary, the common benchmark used in the studies of berberine was 12 weeks [1].

settings.heading: Why does Orenda use HPMC Capsules?
settings.row_content:
If you've ever looked at a supplement label and wondered what the capsule itself is made of, that's exactly the right question to ask. The capsule matters more than most people realize.

Orenda uses HPMC capsules, made from hypromellose — a plant-based material derived from wood pulp cellulose. Unlike traditional gelatin capsules, which are made from animal collagen, HPMC capsules are 100% plant-based and suitable for vegetarian and vegan lifestyles.

They also protect what's inside more effectively. HPMC has a naturally low moisture content, which helps shield sensitive ingredients from humidity and heat, keeping the formula stable from production to the moment you open the bottle. No additives, no preservatives, nothing that doesn't need to be there.

Sourced from a renewable plant material, this formulation detail reflects the same care and attention that goes into every ingredient in this formula.

settings.heading: Should I take Orenda Burn® if I am on medication?
settings.row_content: Orenda Burn® was formulated with careful attention to safety. That said, if you are currently under medical care or taking any medications, we recommend consulting with your healthcare provider before adding any new supplement to your routine. Your healthcare provider understands your full health picture and is the right person to make that call with you.
